source_locator: GCTVI Theorem3.4.2 and Section4.4 fixed-embedding finite generation; P-F16 fixed weight matrix
question: Does one fixed positively multigraded presentation give a generating-degree bound for every ray diagonal independent of the ray?
state: proved: P-F16; all ray diagonals are generated in ray degree at most mDelta, where Delta bounds nonzero square minors of the fixed generator matrix. Positivity of the grading is essential to the bounded cross-section proof.

question: Can that ray-generation bound yield one uniform parameter degree and coefficientwise positivity bound under explicit algebraic hypotheses?
state: proved: under nonconstant diagonal/domain/CM/global-QP hypotheses, L=lcm(1,...,mDelta) supplies an h.s.o.p. all of degreeL, positive numerator H with degree<rL, and s≤p≤max(0,degH−L)≤(dimR−1)L. Full homogeneous normalization and shift proofs supplied.

state: unresolved by this theorem: the l.c.m. can grow too quickly, and no polynomial-time construction is proved. The sufficient quantitative gate is controlled parameter degrees or a sharper argument avoiding this l.c.m. growth; magnitude dependence cannot simply be omitted.
